title: A playtest session, summarised (what Claude writes)
description: km/playtest/summary.py: one tester's session read for the developer, and each of their bug notes written as a public GitHub issue for the developer to approve.

headline.description: One line, under 140 characters: the most useful thing this session shows.

understood.description: Two or three sentences: did they work out what to do, and how long it took.

confusions.description: Up to six moments that look like confusion, from the timeline.

when.description: Session time as m:ss, and the shift if there was one.

what.description: What happened and why it looks like confusion, in one or two sentences.

why.description: Two sentences at most, from the numbers and the tester's answer.

bugs.description: One entry per bug note, in the same order, with `i` copied from the note.

title.description: An issue title under 80 characters, neutral, no tester code.

body.description: The issue body in Markdown: what happened, where and when in the shift, the build and platform. Neutral wording; never the tester code, a name, or a link.

suggestions.description: Up to five concrete changes this session points to.
